summary.text: Father of Cleitus (`cleitus-trojan`), the glorious comrade of Polydamas whom Teucer smote as he drove his horses where the battalions were driven in rout — distinct from Peisenor in the *Odyssey* genealogy of Eurycleia and from Pisenor the suitor of Same.

story.text: Homer names Peisenor only as the father of Cleitus when peerless Teucer, bearing his bent-back bow, smote the Trojan warrior busy with his reins amid the rout that Polydamas and his comrades pressed upon the Argive ships.
